title: Abnormal cases on the network side

entities.name: UL NAS TRANSPORT message
entities.description: Uplink NAS transport message used to carry payload containers from UE to network.

entities.name: Payload container type IE
entities.description: Information element indicating the type of payload container (N1 SM information, SMS, LPP, UE policy, location services, CIoT user data).

entities.name: Request type IE
entities.description: Information element indicating the type of PDU session request (initial request, existing PDU session, initial emergency request, etc.).

entities.name: Old PDU session ID IE
entities.description: Information element containing the old PDU session identifier during PDU session modification.

entities.name: S-NSSAI IE
entities.description: Information element containing the network slice selection assistance information.

entities.name: DNN IE
entities.description: Information element containing the data network name.

entities.name: Additional information IE
entities.description: Information element containing routing information for location services and LPP messages.

entities.name: SMF selection procedure
entities.description: Procedure where AMF selects an SMF for PDU session establishment based on various conditions and parameters.

entities.name: Timer T3447
entities.description: Timer related to service gap control that affects NAS message processing when running.

entities.name: SMF selection fails
entities.description: Condition where AMF cannot select a suitable SMF for PDU session handling.

entities.name: No PDU session routing context
entities.description: Condition where AMF does not have routing context for a PDU session ID and UE.

entities.name: AMF aborts procedure
entities.description: AMF behavior of terminating the current procedure without forwarding the payload.

entities.name: AMF sends back 5GSM message
entities.description: AMF behavior of returning the 5GSM message to UE when forwarding fails.

relations.description: UL NAS TRANSPORT message contains Payload container type IE.
UL NAS TRANSPORT message contains Request type IE.
UL NAS TRANSPORT message may contain Old PDU session ID IE.
SMF selection procedure is guarded by condition of selection failure.
SMF selection failure condition establishes AMF behavior of sending back 5GSM message.
No routing context condition establishes AMF behavior of sending back 5GSM message.
Timer T3447 running guards the AMF behavior of sending back messages.
Timer T3447 running guards the AMF behavior of aborting procedure.
Payload container type (SMS, LPP, UE policy, location services) guards AMF abort behavior.
